api.title: MuraenaBase API
api.description: Reference for controlling MuraenaTX outputs through the HTTP API.
api.get_only: All API v2 endpoints use the HTTP GET method.
api.base_url_description: Append the required API method path to this address.
api.endpoints_description: All responses are returned as UTF-8 encoded JSON.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: The API key can be provided as a Bearer token or through the X-API-Key header.
authentication.security: Do not place the API key in the URL and do not publish it in client-side JavaScript.

index.title: List methods
index.description: Returns the API name, version and available methods.

list.title: List addresses
list.description: Returns all MuraenaTX address records from the database.

address.title: Get address
address.description: Returns one address record by its internal numeric ID.

get_state.title: Get output state
get_state.description: Finds an output by its unique billing ID and returns its current state.

set_state.title: Set output state
set_state.description: Sets an output state by unique billing ID: 0 — disabled, 1 — enabled, 2 — warning.

tx.title: Transmitter state
tx.description: Returns the current MuraenaTX transmission state.

tx_on.title: Enable transmitter
tx_on.description: Enables MuraenaTX transmission and saves the state in the device NVS.

tx_off.title: Disable transmitter
tx_off.description: Disables MuraenaTX transmission and saves the state in the device NVS.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: When an error occurs, the server returns a JSON object containing the error field.
errors.bad_request: invalid ID, billing ID, state or request path
errors.unauthorized: the API key is missing or invalid
errors.not_found: the record, billing ID or API method was not found
errors.method_not_allowed: an HTTP method other than GET was used
errors.gateway: communication error with the MuraenaTX device

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: Addresses currently stored in the transmitter memory

sync.confirm: All data on MuraenaTX will be erased and synchronized with the database. Continue?
